title: Willamette Valley Wine Tour with Lunch
includes: Wine country picnic style lunch at a winery
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join an all day Willamette Valley Wine Tour, and get a taste of the most decadent wines the lush Willamette Valley has to offer. Whether you are a wine tasting veteran or a newcomer, there is something for you. Our guides are second to none all with many years experience in the ways of the Willamette Valley and its many vineyards. They will usher you to 3 separate wineries over 7.5 hours, where you will have the opportunitie to taste the famous Pinot Noir, Pinot Gris, Riesling, and other varieties that are unique to the region.
